psu.basis: Official Mean Well top-view AC pair pitch7.5 and DC four-pole pitch5; head/mouth heights and end insets from representative reference model. The physical labels follow the published top view, separate from older nominal logical wire assignments.

relay-1.basis: Calipered overall relay reference and representative three-pole side-entry block. Screw heads +Z are modeled; wire mouth at +X end / Z6.5 is a stated best estimate because source formerly conflates top screw approach and conductor entry.

relay-2.basis: Calipered overall relay reference and representative three-pole side-entry block. Screw heads +Z are modeled; wire mouth at +X end / Z6.5 is a stated best estimate because source formerly conflates top screw approach and conductor entry.

estimate_limits: The JST dimensions are official nominal dimensions; the purchased XUNPU/CQRobot equivalents are represented by those nominal envelopes.
The housing body is7.5 mm plus0.25 mm bottom detail; width and depth are maximum envelopes.
A6 mm pull gives clearance beyond the7 mm shroud from the2.05 mm mating floor; it is a geometric service allowance, not an official extraction-stroke specification.
3 mm straight exit,4 mm centerline bend radius and8 mm tangent run are explicit lead-shaping estimates for1.7 mm silicone conductors. No large finger volume is asserted.
Driver cylinders model a3.5 mm diameter straight working shaft for40 mm above each screw, without a handle/finger envelope.
